armies_of_renown.name: Murkvast Menagerie
armies_of_renown.text:
When you pick the Kruleboyz faction for your army, you can choose for it to be a Murkvast Menagerie Army of Renown. If you do so, use the faction rules on these pages instead of the Kruleboyz faction rules. Every unit in your army must be drawn from the units listed in the roster options box below. All units in your army gain the MURKVAST MENAGERIE keyword.
ROSTER OPTIONS
Swampboss Skumdrekk (must be included and must be your general)
Snatchaboss on Sludgeraker Beast
Killaboss on Corpse-rippa Vulcha
Breaka-boss on Mirebrute Troggoth
Marshcrawla Sloggoth
For every KRULEBOYZ HERO MONSTER you include, you can include a Swampcalla Shaman and Pot-grot
For every KRULEBOYZ HERO MONSTER you include, you can include a non-HERO KRULEBOYZ INFANTRY unit.
You cannot include Regiments of Renown
You cannot include faction terrain

battle_traits.name: Crawly Swarm
battle_traits.effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for combat attacks that target friendly MURKVAST MENAGERIE units while they are wholly within 12" of a friendly MURKVAST MENAGERIE MONSTER that has not charged this turn.

battle_traits.name: Propa Grisly
battle_traits.declare: Pick a friendly MURKVAST MENAGERIE MONSTER unit that has not used any RAMPAGE abilities this turn to use this ability. Then, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.
battle_traits.effect:
Roll a number of dice equal to the Health characteristic of that MURKVAST MENAGERIE MONSTER. For each 6+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.
After this ability has been resolved, this unit cannot use any other RAMPAGE abilities for the rest of the turn.

battle_traits.name: After It, Ladz!
battle_traits.declare: Pick a friendly MURKVAST MENAGERIE MONSTER unit that was not set up this turn to be the target.
battle_traits.effect: The target can move up to 3". It can move into combat. If it was in combat at the start of the move, it must end that move in combat.

entries.name: Skinwriggla Larvae
entries.declare: Pick an objective within 6" of this unit to be infested with bugs for the rest of the battle.
entries.effect:
While an enemy unit is contesting an objective that is infested with bugs:
• Subtract 3 from that unit's control score.
• Ignore positive modifiers to that unit's control score.

entries.name: Morkish Mist
entries.declare: Pick a friendly MURKVAST MENAGERIE WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly MURKVAST MENAGERIE INFANTRY unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect: Until the start of your next turn, the target has WARD (5+).

entries.name: Summon Foot of Gork
entries.declare: If there is not a friendly Foot of Gork on the battlefield, pick a friendly MURKVAST MENAGERIE WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect: Set up a Foot of Gork wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units. A Foot of Gork has 2 parts that must be set up within 9" of each other.
